visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A high-contrast close-up shot features a circular charcoal grill where intense orange flames lick through the metal mesh to sear a slice of beef. A pair of silver metal tongs, held by an unseen person, actively flips the meat. The background consists of dark, blurred restaurant decor and a tiled wall. (2) The scene transitions to a medium shot of an ornate, pink-lacquered jewelry box with golden floral motifs. Inside, multiple thick slabs of highly marbled raw beef are meticulously arranged on a bed of bright green curly parsley, appearing as a luxury presentation. (3) A hand enters the frame using metal tongs to transfer a thick, square cut of raw beef onto the hot grill surface. Above the grill, a retractable silver metal exhaust hood hangs closely to suction the rising white smoke. The background shows wooden wall panels. (4) A prepared black iron skillet is presented, filled with perfectly cooked medium-rare beef slices, grilled king oyster mushrooms, and green peppers. Three hands bring glasses of beer and orange juice together in the center of the frame for a celebratory toast. (5) A finger taps on a digital ordering tablet mounted on a wall, scrolling through a menu labeled in Traditional Chinese that lists various VIP Sets with prices in Korean Won. (6) A montage shows three diners enjoying the meal: first, a young boy with black-rimmed glasses chews meat and gives a thumbs-up; then, a woman in a white blouse takes a large bite and smiles; finally, a man with glasses wraps a piece of meat in a large lettuce leaf before eating. (7) A steaming, bubbling earthenware pot of rich brown soybean paste stew is placed on the wooden tabletop, filled with visible vegetables and tofu. The camera then pans across the empty, clean wooden booths of the restaurant interior. (8) The video concludes with exterior shots showing a red menu stand in a hallway and finally the street-level view of the restaurant entrance, featuring a bright white sign with the name 일편등심 and various surrounding urban business signs.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 韓牛初體驗 也~太好吃了吧! [Logo]: 韓國失心瘋. (2) [Subtitle]: 全程都有歐巴幫忙烤 不慌不忙超輕鬆. (3) [Subtitle]: 專業的就是不一樣 烤得超級美味，張嘴就能吃. (4) [Subtitle]: 乾杯. (5) [Subtitle]: 我們三人點了VIP套餐. (6) [Subtitle]: VIP套餐上菜很浮誇 裡面的韓牛油花超美. (7) [Subtitle]: 除了韓牛，還有附菇類、蔬菜 非常豐富. (8) [Subtitle]: 當然也少不了小菜. (9) [Subtitle]: 每塊肉烤完沒幾秒 馬上就被夾走. (10) [Subtitle]: 兒子說超軟嫩、好好吃. (11) [Subtitle]: 我喜歡單純沾點鹽 直接吃最原始的味道. (12) [Subtitle]: 韓牛吃起來跟和牛 很不一樣耶，比較不膩口. (13) [Subtitle]: 這家是 一片里脊江南店 일편등심 강남점. (14) [Subtitle]: 各種部位都好吃 菜包肉也讚到不行. (15) [Subtitle]: 吃完烤肉 上了一鍋大醬湯飯 三個人一起嗑光光，太好吃了. (16) [Subtitle]: 店內座位乾淨明亮. (17) [Subtitle]: 餐廳在地下一樓. (18) [Subtitle]: 就在江南站附近巷子 地點超方便唷.

The sound has a short spectral bandwidth and a clear, resonant decay typical of high-quality glassware.
